description: PAID ($0.0045 USDC via x402). A US-listed company's financials as it filed them with the SEC (XBRL company facts), by ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or CIK: for its last 1-12 fiscal years (10-K) or three-month quarters — revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders' equity, cash, operating cash flow, shares outstanding — each with the us-gaap tag it came from, the fiscal year/period and the filing. Restatements win; a value the company did not tag is null, never computed (no derived Q4). US-GAAP filers only (not IFRS). An unknown ticker or an SEC outage answers 404/502 and is not charged. Public-domain data, not investment advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

period.description: annual (fiscal years, from 10-K filings; default) or quarterly (three-month periods)

ticker.description: Stock ticker (AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B) or the company's SEC CIK number

name: company_financials

asOf.description: ISO time EDGAR was read (cached reads keep their read time)

concepts.description: For each field: the us-gaap tags in fallback order, and the ones this answer used

currency.description: USD — only US-dollar facts are read (EPS in USD per share, shares as a count)

defaulted.description: Present only when the body named no field: which company the answer is for, and why

note.description: The selection rules, the limits, and the licence

periods.description: The periods, newest first; a value the company did not tag for that period is null

concepts.description: For each field, the us-gaap tag this row's value came from (null = not reported)

fiscalYear.description: The company's fiscal year for this period, as its own report states it; null when no report of its own is in the data

form.description: The report that covered this period as its own (10-K, 10-Q …)

latestFiled.description: The newest filing date among this row's values (a later filing's restated comparative wins)

periodEnd.description: The last day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD)

title: Company financials from SEC XBRL ($0.0045)
